## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 31. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke frames it as a long-delayed succession: after basically a decade of being the head coach-in-waiting — except for a short period of time after a scandal involving the use of racial stereotypes — Scalley gets his shot with Whittingham off to Michigan. He notes Scalley coached the Utes in the Las Vegas Bowl to a 44-22 win and is now the full-time man. He then sets out the roots: the Salt Lake City native played at Utah and has coached at Utah since 2007, serving as DC for the last 10 seasons, so he certainly knows the programme and is plenty familiar with the recruiting pipelines. His verdict is deliberately provisional — it may work out, though year three in the Big 12 might be a little bit rocky.
